customers.name: customers

products.name: products

orders.name: orders
orders.raw_code:
source: orders is duckdb.table('data/orders.parquet') extend {
  primary_key: id
  join_one: customers on customer_id = customers.id
  join_one: products on product_id = products.id

  # Dimensions (Calculated Columns)
  dimension: line_item_amount is price * quantity

  # Measures (Reusable Business Aggregations)
  measure:
    total_revenue is sum(line_item_amount)
    total_orders is count()
    avg_order_value is total_revenue / total_orders
    high_value_order_count is count() { where: line_item_amount >= 300.0 }

  # Reusable View 1: Customer Performance Breakdown
  view: customer_performance is {
    group_by: customers.name, customers.segment, customers.state
    aggregate:
      total_orders
      total_revenue
      avg_order_value
  }

  # Reusable View 2: Product Category Revenue
  view: category_performance is {
    group_by: products.category, customers.segment
    aggregate: total_revenue
  }

  # Reusable View 3: Daily Revenue Trend
  view: daily_sales_trend is {
    group_by: order_date
    aggregate: total_revenue, total_orders
  }
}

high_value_orders.name: high_value_orders

executive_sales.name: executive_sales
executive_sales.description: Asset 3: Executive Sales Dashboard (Annotated Visual Report)
executive_sales.raw_code:
query: executive_sales is orders -> {
  aggregate:
    total_revenue
    total_orders
    avg_order_value

  # Nested Query 1: Product Category Breakdown
  # @bar_chart
  nest: category_performance

  # Nested Query 2: Daily Sales Trend
  # @line_chart
  nest: daily_sales_trend

  # Nested Query 3: Top VIP Customers Table
  nest: top_customers is {
    group_by: customers.name, customers.segment
    aggregate: total_revenue
    limit: 5
  }
}

check_valid_customer_ids.name: check_valid_customer_ids
check_valid_customer_ids.description: Check 1: Verify all orders have valid, non-null customer IDs

check_positive_prices.name: check_positive_prices
check_positive_prices.description: Check 2: Verify all order prices are strictly positive
